notes: HUD layouts: Default, Dungeons, Mining, Farming and Fishing can each have their own HUD layout, picked at the top of /jerry hud
The mod switches layout by where you are (a fishing rod in your hand counts as fishing). Turn Auto-switch off in /jerry hud
Tracker counts on your HUD: in /jerry gui, pick a tracker and press Show on HUD. Move it with /jerry hud
Show your counts, everyone's added together, or each player's (the Mine / Everyone / Players button in /jerry gui)
Players view: a card per player with their skin's face, the tracker and what they've collected
Pick players: a face for everyone who linked the mod, click to add or remove their card, or type any name (/jerry hud players, /jerry hud add <name>)
What's changed: the update box lists every change since your version, and after updating a chat message links to them
/jerry changelog shows every version's changes, and the mod page has a full changelog
Quick call uses the exact name /call takes for each contact (Maddox the Slayer is /call maddox, Feast Baker Scott is /call Scott, Spider Tamer is /call SpiderTamer, Crag is /call kuudra...)
Hover a contact to see the exact /call it will run
Quick call menu: /ace call (or set a Quick call key in Controls) shows your Abiphone contacts as heads. Click to call, right-click or F to star
New Quick call menu: /ace call (or set a Quick call key in Controls) shows your Abiphone contacts as heads, like the storage viewer
Click a contact to call them (Hypixel's /call). Search by name or where they are, sort A-Z or by recent
Right-click or F stars a contact so it pins to the top; middle-click removes one
Open your Abiphone once (each page) and the mod remembers your contacts
HUD editor: Ctrl+Z undoes your last change (move, resize, put back, Reset all) and Ctrl+Y redoes it
Drag a corner of any HUD part to resize it, like a picture in Word: the opposite corner stays put and it keeps its shape
Scrolling over a part still resizes it in 10% steps
/jerry hud shows other mods' HUD parts too (Skyblocker, SkyHanni, Odin and more) plus Minecraft's own; right-click one for that mod's settings
/jerry hud now shows other mods' HUD parts too (Skyblocker, SkyHanni, Odin and more), plus Minecraft's own: scoreboard, boss bar, potion effects, hotbar
Drag any of them to move it and scroll to resize. Purple boxes are Ace, blue boxes are other mods
Right-click another mod's part to open that mod's settings; shift+right-click puts any part back
A list down the side opens each HUD mod's settings, so their own HUD editors are all one click away
Reset all puts every part back, Ace's and other mods'
Keep several plans: craft plans and shard plans are all saved, and the ◀ ▶ buttons in /jerry plan switch between them
Save a copy of your website plan, or delete a saved one, from /jerry plan
New HUD editor (/jerry hud, or Edit HUD in /jerry settings): drag every Ace HUD part, scroll to resize, right-click to reset
The loot reveal strip can now be moved and resized too
Fusion Machine helper: a panel beside the Fusion Machine shows your plan's next fusion and what you still need
The shards that go into that fusion get a gold outline. Turn it off under Extras
/jerry update now checks the site again every time you type it
The automatic update check runs once, when you open the Multiplayer server list
New /jerry shards menu: real shard icons, an icon bar for each type, and how many you need for max
Hover a shard's icon for its lore. Click it for how to get it, or its fusion tree
Swap any step in a fusion tree (break down, hunt instead, or another recipe), and pick a goal level or Max
Push a shard path to the site's Fusion planner and back. /ace works the same as /jerry
